title: Concurrent Inventory Overselling
business_scenario: A flash sale item has exactly 1 unit left in stock. Multiple customers hit checkout concurrently.
symptoms: Both checkouts succeed, inventory drops below zero or multiple orders are fulfilled for a single physical unit.
reproduction_steps: Send two concurrent requests to reserveStock for quantity 1.
Inspect final product stock and reservation success flags.
expected_behavior: Only one reservation must succeed. The other must fail with an out-of-stock error. Final stock must be 0, never negative.
actual_behavior: Both callers read stock = 1 before either decrements, resulting in both passing the availability check.
root_cause: Non-atomic read-then-write pattern in inventory.service.js without a critical section lock or transactional mutex.
acceptance_criteria: When stock is 1 and N concurrent reservations occur, exactly 1 succeeds and N-1 fail with Out of stock.
reference_fix: Wrap stock availability check and decrement in an atomic critical section mutex in inventory.service.js.
